description.title: נכס שנמצא
description.summary: This table outlines the process for handling stolen property that is recovered, either before or after insurance benefits are paid. It details the transfer of ownership and potential reimbursement of funds.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את הטיפול ברכוש גנוב שנמצא, לפני או אחרי תשלום תגמולי ביטוח. במקרה שנכס גנוב נמצא לפני תשלום תגמולים, הנכס יוחזר למבוטח, אלא אם הנכס ניזוק. אם הנכס נמצא לאחר תשלום תגמולים, המבטח יודיע למבוטח או להפך. הנכס שנמצא יעבור לבעלות המבטח, אלא אם המבוטח מודיע למבטח תוך 30 יום כי הוא מעוניין לקבל את הנכס בתמורה להחזרת תגמולי הביטוח. פוליסת אדירה כסף מספקת הנחיות ברורות לגבי נכסים שנמצאו.

42. Property Found
42.1 If property which was stolen is found prior to payment of insurance benefits under this Policy, the property will be returned to the Insured, and the insurer shall not pay insurance benefits unless the returned property was damaged.
42.2 If property that was stolen is found after insurance benefits are paid, the insurer shall inform the insured or vice versa. The property found will transfer to the ownership of the insurer unless the insured notifies the insurer - within 30 days after notification by the insurer or insured as the case may be - that he wishes to receive the property found, in exchange for returning the insurance benefits to the insurer during the said period.

טבלה: נכס שנמצא
This table outlines the process for handling stolen property that is recovered, either before or after insurance benefits are paid. It details the transfer of ownership and potential reimbursement of funds.
ממדים: Scenario regarding found stolen property, Actions and ownership transfer

42. Property Found
42.1 If property which was stolen is found prior to payment of insurance benefits under this Policy, the property will be returned to the Insured, and the insurer shall not pay insurance benefits unless the returned property was damaged.
42.2 If property that was stolen is found after insurance benefits are paid, the insurer shall inform the insured or vice versa. The property found will transfer to the ownership of the insurer unless the insured notifies the insurer - within 30 days after notification by the insurer or insured as the case may be - that he wishes to receive the property found, in exchange for returning the insurance benefits to the insurer during the said period.
